page: Microsoft Azure NC80adis_H100_v5 is an isolated, GPU-accelerated virtual machine belonging to the NCadsH100v5 server family. It features 80 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is equipped with 640.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

For hardware acceleration and high-speed data access, this server configuration integrates two GPUs and 7942 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. The instance is also Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments alongside the high-capacity local solid-state storage.

Given the high density of dedicated AMD CPU cores, dual GPU accelerators, and substantial local NVMe storage, this instance is positioned for resource-intensive workloads. It is qualitatively structured for high-end workloads where the hardware cost is offset by the massive parallel processing capabilities and local storage throughput. Suitable workloads include deep learning training, large-scale AI inference, high-performance computing, and complex database operations requiring isolated hardware environments.
